metadata.description: Mobile app development plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: accessibility-mobile
plugins.description: iOS VoiceOver, Android TalkBack, Flutter Semantics, WCAG 2.1 compliance for production mobile apps.

plugins.name: app-store-optimization
plugins.description: ASO, metadata, screenshots, A/B testing, ratings

plugins.name: camera-media
plugins.description: iOS AVFoundation, Android CameraX/Camera2, Flutter camera, ARKit/ARCore, image/video processing.

plugins.name: cross-platform-patterns
plugins.description: Flutter platform channels, Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile, React Native New Architecture, shared code architecture.

plugins.name: deep-linking
plugins.description: iOS Universal Links, Android App Links, custom URL schemes, deferred deep linking, in-app routing.

plugins.name: flutter-development
plugins.description: Flutter 3.16+, Dart 3.x, all major platforms (iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, Linux).

plugins.name: gesture-interaction
plugins.description: UIGestureRecognizer, SwiftUI gestures, Android GestureDetector/MotionEvent, Flutter GestureDetector, haptic feedback, custom recognizers, velocity-based physics.

plugins.name: kotlin-android
plugins.description: Kotlin coroutines, Jetpack Compose, ViewModel + StateFlow, Room, Hilt, WorkManager.

plugins.name: location-services
plugins.description: iOS CoreLocation, Android FusedLocationProvider, Flutter geolocator, geofencing, geocoding, MapKit/Google Maps/flutter_map.

plugins.name: mobile-analytics
plugins.description: Firebase Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer attribution, Crashlytics, Sentry — event taxonomy, funnels, crash reporting.

plugins.name: mobile-architecture
plugins.description: Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVI, iOS Coordinator pattern, Android Navigation Component, feature modules, feature flags.

plugins.name: mobile-ci-cd
plugins.description: Fastlane, GitHub Actions, code signing (iOS match, Android keystore), TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution, Google Play.

plugins.name: mobile-payments
plugins.description: Apple StoreKit 2, Google Play Billing Library 6+, RevenueCat, Stripe, subscription lifecycle management.

plugins.name: mobile-performance
plugins.description: iOS Instruments, Android Profiler, Flutter DevTools, launch time, memory management, rendering at 60/120fps.

plugins.name: mobile-security
plugins.description: iOS Keychain, Android Keystore, certificate pinning, biometric authentication, network security config, R8/ProGuard obfuscation.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: XCTest, XCUITest, Espresso, Compose testing, Flutter widget/integration tests, Detox, Firebase Test Lab, golden screenshot regression.

plugins.name: offline-first
plugins.description: Core Data, Room, Drift, background sync with BGTaskScheduler/WorkManager, conflict resolution strategies.

plugins.name: push-notifications
plugins.description: APNs JWT auth, FCM HTTP v1, Android notification channels (API 26+), rich notifications with UNNotificationServiceExtension, silent push, all-state handling (foreground/background/terminated).

plugins.name: react-native
plugins.description: New Architecture (JSI/TurboModules/Fabric), Expo EAS, React Navigation, Reanimated 3, Zustand, TanStack Query, MMKV storage.

plugins.name: swift-ios
plugins.description: Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, AsyncStream), SwiftUI (ViewBuilder, PreferenceKey, Layout protocol), UIViewRepresentable, Combine, SwiftData, Swift Package Manager, Swift macros.
